verdict.rationale: Shortwave ships AI automations such as triggers, plain-English AI filters and MCP integrations, so a sandbox or test mode for safely trying them is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test environment or dry-run mode. Undo send is a related recovery feature, not isolation from production data, and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
